description: Indiana University deposits temperature and precipitation simulations for the United States Midwest covering 1951 to 2100. WRF version 3.9 dynamically downscales NCEP/NCAR reanalysis and CESM1 historical and RCP8.5 runs, then applies bias correction. The public DataCORE landing identifies a three-kilometre horizontal grid, two compressed NetCDF variable files and a small archive of downscaling method scripts. It labels the deposit CC-BY-4.0 and provides open file access without charge. The DataCite rights metadata instead point to CC-BY-2.0, so the provider landing should be checked before redistribution. The dataset supplies regional climate forcing for urban heat, drainage, building-energy and water-demand simulations. It is one downscaling chain and one future emissions pathway, not a full ensemble of futures. The metadata do not establish equal skill across seasons or local terrain. It complements broader climate products such as data-cmip6-climate-projections-cds at a finer Midwest grid. The files were not downloaded or run.
